name: Cyber Clock (StickS3)
description: Cyberpunk desk clock for M5StickS3: NTP timekeeping, a column-trail digital-rain engine with 6 character sets, 6 neon palettes, 40-band microphone spectrum, IMU shake-to-theme and a three-stage power save (60 s down-clock, 180 s Light Sleep with button wake). Setup is big-text now: carousel WiFi picker, magnified password keypad, or hold BtnA and scan a QR code to enter credentials from your phone. | M5StickS3 赛博朋克桌面时钟：NTP 自动对时、6 种字符集的列轨迹数字雨、6 套霓虹配色、40 段麦克风频谱、摇一摇换主题，三段式省电（60 秒降频 / 180 秒 Light Sleep + 按键唤醒）。配网全是大字：轮播选 WiFi、密码放大可核对，长按 BtnA 出二维码手机扫码输。
author: andjiang0083

versions.change_log: Big-text provisioning on StickS3: carousel WiFi picker (current network 3× centred, neighbours visible), magnified password keypad (6× current char with ±1/±2 in view, no cell boxes), QR phone provisioning (hold BtnA → open AP CyberClock-<MAC tail>, scan and type WiFi + password on your phone, timezone auto-detected), open networks connect without a prompt. Cardputer binary unchanged.

Review fixes (no visual change): USB power detection now uses VBUS voltage, so a fully charged StickS3 on a cable no longer dims and sleeps; Light Sleep button wake armed on the correct pin (GPIO11) with a wider post-wake sampling window; the WiFi radio is always shut down after a cancelled or failed setup pass; a single transient mic failure no longer kills the spectrum; sprite allocation failure now shows 'SPRITE FAIL' instead of a black screen.
First public release. Three display modes, six rain character sets, six themes, timezone picker, microphone spectrum, and a fixed long-press double-trigger. Cardputer build reaches feature parity.

name: Cyber Clock (Cardputer)
description: Cyberpunk desk clock for M5Cardputer: the same 240x135 clock with physical-keyboard controls, NTP timekeeping, column-trail digital rain with 6 character sets, 6 neon palettes, 40-band microphone spectrum and IMU shake-to-theme. Power save down-clocks to 80 MHz + 1 fps (no Light Sleep: the keyboard sits behind an I2C expander). | M5Cardputer 赛博朋克桌面时钟：同一块 240x135 时钟，改用物理键盘操作；NTP 自动对时、6 种字符集的列轨迹数字雨、6 套霓虹配色、40 段麦克风频谱、摇一摇换主题。省电降频到 80MHz + 1fps（无 Light Sleep：键盘挂在 I²C 扩展芯片后面）。
author: andjiang0083

versions.change_log: Review fixes (no visual change): PSRAM disabled (Cardputer-Adv has none and the build never used it), timezone screen key direction matched to the WiFi list, mic hiccups no longer disable the spectrum permanently, USB power save gating, and the on-screen keyboard's last cell no longer clips off-screen.
First public release. Keyboard controls (S/R/C/W/+/-), timezone picker, microphone spectrum, IMU shake-to-theme, and the same rain engine and palettes as the StickS3 build.
